content.title: Brand Promo Video Generator
content.summary: Build a promotional film from verifiable brand facts, visible product evidence, and a clear call to action. The Seedance companion emphasizes traceable assets, credible copy, and cause-and-effect product proof.

quick_start.input_format: Verified brand facts + product identity + visible benefit and operation proofs + approved copy + call to action + traceable assets
quick_start.recommended_input: Organize a promotional video around verifiable brand facts, visible product evidence, and one call to action; the Seedance companion emphasizes traceable asset roles, credible copy, and product cause-and-effect proof.
required_anchors: Use the pinned official MiniMax H3 upstream Skill.
Use the independent Seedance 2.0 companion for Seedance.
Do not copy the upstream Skill body or duplicate it into ComfyUI.
usage_steps: Choose the matching official MiniMax H3 Skill and install it from the pinned upstream link.
Prepare only the assets and facts required by that Skill.
Use the independent Seedance companion when targeting Seedance 2.0.
Validate identity, timing, text and asset responsibilities before generation.
applicable_scope: Organize a promotional video around verifiable brand facts, visible product evidence, and one call to action; the Seedance companion emphasizes traceable asset roles, credible copy, and product cause-and-effect proof.
Projects that match the upstream Skill's declared purpose and asset contract.
not_suitable_for: Tasks outside the upstream Skill's declared scope.
Cases that require copying the upstream Skill body into this library or importing it into the T8 ComfyUI node.

creative_dna.usage_scope: Organize a promotional video around verifiable brand facts, visible product evidence, and one call to action; the Seedance companion emphasizes traceable asset roles, credible copy, and product cause-and-effect proof.
